brief: Create a joyful Instagram post celebrating Cake Me artisan cakes. Use the certified colours, real logo and approved product photos. Do not invent prices or offers.

copy.angle: Everyday moment turned celebration: a joyful, sensory close-up of the cheesecake that makes any day shareable
copy.caption:
Plot twist: an ordinary day just became a celebration! 🌟

Golden, creamy, baked-to-perfection cheesecake that makes you stop mid-scroll and say "yes, please!" That's what we make at Cake-me: artisanal cheesecakes made for sharing, laughing and turning regular moments into ones you'll remember. 💛

So grab your favourite people (or don't, we won't judge if you keep it all to yourself 😉) and make today a little sweeter. 🩷

Tell us: who are you sharing your next slice with? 👇
copy.cta: Tag the person you'd share a slice with!
claims: Cake-me's cheesecakes turn everyday moments into memorable, shareable celebrations of happiness

image_brief.subject: Close-up of a freshly baked cheesecake slice showing its creamy, golden-brown texture, resting on kraft paper packaging. Use the approved product photo as reference.
image_brief.composition: Minimalist, product-focused overhead framing. The slice sits slightly off-centre with generous clean space around it for the typeset overlay line. Close and inviting, not distant.
image_brief.light: Natural, soft overhead daylight with warm, gentle shadows that bring out the golden-brown tones.
image_brief.negative: no text, no letters, no logo, no signage, no labels, no packaging printing

items.html: Today deserves a cheesecake 💛
